notes.title: New Character Episode "Kiko 2" Added and Upcoming Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Addition of character episode "Kiko 2"![/h1]

In ver1.2.0, a new episode "Kiko 2" has been added!
A new character episode "Kiko 2" has been added in ver1.2.0!
After the character episode "Kiko", you will find out what Kiko met and what she thought... The story of Kiko will be continued.

When the character episode "Kiko 2" is completed
Kiko will appear in the post-ending content, and you will be able to temporarily accompany her!



[h1]Upcoming updates[/h1]

Starting with "Kiko 2" added in ver. 1.2.0, we will be updating all of the content in the game.
We plan to add the second part of the character episodes for all character episodes that have been implemented so far as well.

The following character episodes will be added
Kiko 2 (already added in ver 1.2.0)
Shino 2
Minamo 2
Hinase 2
Akane 2
Itsuka 2


In addition to the above, we are planning to add more scenarios and other updates to natsuno-kanata.
We look forward to your continued support of natsuno-kanata.

notes.title: natsuno-kanata ver0.6.4 released
notes.content:
natsuno-kanata ver0.6.4 has been released.
The main contents of the update are as follows


[Contents after the ending]
Five new "Collectibles" items have been added.
Added "Camera", "Film", and "Photo" items.
　If you use the camera with film in your possession, you can obtain a photo.
　If you search for a specified number of times with a photo, you will be able to reach the location in the photo.
You can now exchange collected items and other items for other items.
　You can meet the collector character while exploring the content after the ending.


[The following are the changes made to the game]
The specifications of tool items such as "flashlights" and "screwdrivers" have been changed.
　You will now be able to use the item and enter the target object.
　Starting from ver. 0.6.4, tool items can be equipped and will be used automatically while equipped.
The order of the items in the storage cabinet has been changed.
　（The order of the items in the storage cabinet has been changed so that the newly acquired items come first.)
(Newly acquired items will be placed at the top of the list.) - Filters and sorting of the storage shelf will be maintained until the game is quit.


[Newly acquired items will be moved to the top of the list]
Added a function that allows characters to ask for permission to use recovery items when their health or hunger level drops below a certain level.
You can now choose your favorite and least favorite dishes for each character.
　When you use your favorite dish, you will recover more energy than usual.
　When you use a dish you are not good at, the amount of energy you recover will be lower than usual.


[Adjustment]
Some text has been adjusted.
The drop rate of some items has been adjusted.
Adjusted the occurrence rate of some events.
